headings.usage: Use for all main section titles, hero headlines, and numbers. Apply tight tracking for impact.
headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl uppercase font-bold tracking-tighter leading-tight

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, labels, secondary text. Keep leading relaxed.

application_rules.primary: Use for high-contrast sections like the Header, Hero text containers, Footer, and active states. Gives a 'dark mode' vibe despite light background.
application_rules.secondary: Use for primary CTA buttons (Call Now), hover states, and highlighting key trust metrics. Text on secondary should be #111111.
application_rules.accent: ONLY use for emergency elements (Emergency Mobile Call Bar, Urgent Badges, Error States).
application_rules.light_section: Alternate section background (e.g., Why Choose Us, Reviews, Form area).
application_rules.text: Default text color on light backgrounds. Use #FFFFFF on primary backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use clean, solid-color offset shadows for cards (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#111111]) to create a structured, trustworthy, no-nonsense vibe. Avoid soft, muddy blurs.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px or 2px solid #111111 on cards, form inputs, and buttons.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: rounded-lg or rounded-xl for a modern, approachable feel under stress. Keep it consistent.
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle and fast. Under-stress users want instant feedback. Hover: -translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-200.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: AVOID in emergency contexts. Use solid, opaque colors to maximize legibility and speed.

grids_and_layouts.hero: Relative container with full background image and heavy dark overlay (bg-black/60). Left-aligned content block on desktop, center-aligned on mobile. Prominent phone number and massive CTA buttons.
grids_and_layouts.services_grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 md:gap-6. Use solid cards.
grids_and_layouts.service_area: Flex or Grid layout: 1/3 text and city list, 2/3 map placeholder (a gray box with a map icon).
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first_rules: Always stack content on mobile. Keep forms extremely short. Provide massive tap targets.

header.description: Sticky at top (z-40). Solid #111111 background, white text. Contains text logo 'ALLAN TOWING CO.', Phone Number (909) 278-2226, Language toggle (EN/ES), and a prominent 'Call Now' button in #FFC400.

hero.description: Headline: '24/7 Emergency Towing in Fontana, CA'. Subheadline explaining speed and reliability. Buttons: 'Call Now' (#FFC400) and 'Text My Location' (outline white). Include Trust Badges below buttons.

emergency_services.description: 6 cards (Emergency Towing, Flatbed Towing, Jump Start, Lockout, Tire Change, Fuel Delivery). Include lucide-react icons. 2-sentence description, small 'Request' CTA.

lead_form.description: GHL placeholder form inside a distinct #F6F6F6 section. Inputs: Name, Phone, Current Location, Vehicle, Problem. Submit button full-width #111111.

reviews_and_faq.description: Horizontal scrolling carousel for Google reviews placeholder. Accordion (Shadcn) for FAQ (Cost, response time, 24/7, insurance, Spanish).

mobile_call_bar.description: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-[#D32F2F] flex justify-center items-center shadow-[0_-4px_10px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] z-50 md:hidden. Button: 'TAP TO CALL - (909) 278-2226' in bright white font-bold text-lg.

floating_chat.description: fixed bottom-6 right-6 w-14 h-14 bg-[#111111] text-white rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg z-40 hidden md:flex (since mobile has the bottom bar).

hero_background.description: Black flatbed tow truck on road during daytime. Apply a black/70 overlay to allow text readability.

roadside_assistance.description: Car on the side of the road, representing breakdown scenario. Good for Why Choose Us or Services context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'Oswald' and 'Inter' fonts via Google Fonts in index.html.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the locked colors: primary '#111111', secondary '#FFC400', accent '#D32F2F', light '#F6F6F6'.
Build the Sticky Mobile Call bar (fixed bottom-0 z-50) using the #D32F2F accent color. Only show on md:hidden.
Implement language toggle visually (no functional translation needed, just EN/ES state highlight).
Ensure large tap targets (min 48px height) for all buttons and links.
Do NOT use generic generic vector illustrations. Use the provided Unsplash URLs or clean geometric map placeholders.
Add data-testid on all forms, CTAs, and interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='hero-call-button').
Keep the Shadcn Form, Accordion, and Dialog clean—override default styles with hard borders to match the aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Opt for strong left-aligned typography.
Do not use AI emoji characters.
Ensure every interaction has a clear hover/active state.
Prioritize accessibility: Use clear focus rings.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in header. Use solid #111111.
Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactivity (Form, Accordion), customized to the brand.
